title: Released Windows updater locks its own console launcher
signatures: failed to remove file[^\r\n]*Scripts[/\\]x19\.exe[^\r\n]*Access is denied\. \(os error 5\)
explanation: The March/April Windows updater is already running from x19.exe when uv tries to replace it. Windows refuses the locked launcher. The update target cannot change that loaded code; re-running the installer is a separate recovery route.

title: July script installs offer a manual update instead of an app hand-off
errors: ^E2E ASSERTION FAILED: app driven via captured x19 desktop spec; update completed$
^E2E ASSERTION FAILED: GUI driver clicked Update now and the app quit for hand-off$
signatures: \[updates\] no staged updater; surfacing manual `x19 update` for CLI install at
explanation: The July Windows app has no staged updater after a script install. Its Update button explicitly returns manual: x19 update without starting a hand-off. Desktop-installer installs are not covered by this exception.
